tasks.FindGCD: Finding the greatest common divisor (GCD) of the number of white and red tulips to determine the maximum number of identical bouquets that can be made without any flowers left out.
tasks.IdentifyBouquetCombinations: Generating all valid combinations of red and white tulips based on the GCD result.
tasks.ValidateBouquets: Ensuring each combination is unique and meets the condition of having the same number of red and white tulips in each bouquet.
